title: Dates divers asked for
description: Divers who couldn’t find a day that worked, grouped by the day they asked for. Someone shows up under every date they said they could make, so a count here is people who could be on that boat — not people who have booked one. Nothing is held.
emptyDetail: Divers ask from your schedule page and from any course page — “Nothing on a date that works?”. What they send lands here.
